name: Sumit Woods Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1997, Sumit Woods Ltd is in the business of real estate development[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company takes up eco-friendly and large-scale projects like developing townships, commercial malls, farmhouses, second-home resorts, slum rehabilitation and redevelopment projects.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 32.5% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 66.4 to 30.1 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.2% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -11.6%
